wordProblems.q: Liam has 8 pencils. Liam finds 8 more pencils in a drawer. How many pencils does Liam have now?
Mia has 18 balloons. 12 balloons pop. How many balloons does Mia have left?
Zoe has 15 books on her shelf. Her mum buys her 2 more books. How many books does Zoe have now?
James has 11 crayons. He loses 5 crayons at school. How many crayons does James have left?
Adam picks 13 oranges from a tree. Then Adam picks 2 more oranges. How many oranges did Adam pick in all?
There are 10 ducks in a pond. 6 ducks swim away. How many ducks are left in the pond?
Amelia makes 9 cupcakes. Her friend brings 3 more cupcakes. How many cupcakes are there in all?
Mason has 6 toy cars. He gives 5 toy cars to his little brother. How many toy cars does Mason have left?
Adam finds 9 seashells on the beach in the morning and 7 seashells in the afternoon. How many seashells did Adam find in all?
Lily has 14 flowers in her garden. She picks 3 flowers for her teacher. How many flowers are left in the garden?
James eats 12 grapes at lunch and 4 grapes after school. How many grapes did James eat in all?
Jack is reading a book with 18 pages. Jack reads 2 pages today. How many pages are left to read?
A baker makes 17 muffins in the morning and 2 muffins in the afternoon. How many muffins did the baker make in all?
There are 9 fish in a tank. The shop sells 1 fish. How many fish are left in the tank?
Sophia has 5 red beads and 9 blue beads. How many beads does Sophia have in all?
Mason collects 16 toy trains. He lends 15 trains to a friend. How many trains does Mason have left?
Lucas has 8 apples in a basket. Lucas eats 5 apples. How many apples are left in the basket?
Lily draws 18 stars on Monday and 2 stars on Tuesday. How many stars did Lily draw in all?
A monkey has 11 bananas. It eats 5 bananas. How many bananas does the monkey have left?
Mia has 5 apples. Mia buys 15 more apples. How many apples does Mia have now?
Grace has 9 buttons in a box. She uses 6 buttons to sew a dress. How many buttons are left in the box?
Lucas buys 10 peaches at the market. Then Lucas buys 2 more peaches. How many peaches did Lucas buy in all?
There are 20 frogs sitting on a log. 19 frogs jump into the water. How many frogs are left on the log?
Isabella collects 18 smooth rocks at the river and 2 smooth rocks at the lake. How many smooth rocks did Isabella collect in all?
Layla has 20 cherries in a bowl. She gives 6 cherries to her friend. How many cherries are left in the bowl?
10 red buses and 9 yellow buses are parked at the station. How many buses are parked at the station in all?
Ava has 16 pairs of socks in a drawer. Ava takes 14 pairs out to wear this week. How many pairs of socks are left in the drawer?
Liam flies 16 kites in the park. His dad brings 2 more kites. How many kites are there now?
Layla has 10 candies in a jar. She shares 8 candies with her sister. How many candies are left in the jar?
Noah picks 7 lemons from a tree in the morning and 8 lemons in the evening. How many lemons did Noah pick in all?
